title: A completely decomposed finitely presented map admits a finite cover of the target by locally closed pieces of finite presentation over which a section exists

standard_prerequisites.use: Directed-limit presentation of residue fields by finitely presented subalgebras, the Limits chapter lifting proposition for morphisms out of finite presentation targets, Chevalley's constructibility theorem, and the constructible-topology compactness of qcqs schemes.

core_obligations: Rewrite each residue-field section as a filtered colimit of finite presentation immersions.
Lift the section to one finite stage.
Extract finitely many stages covering Y via constructible compactness.

proof_roadmap.step: Compactness in the constructible topology yields the finite decomposition.

difficulty_reason: If f : X -> Y is completely decomposed (every residue field of Y admits a section through X) and locally of finite presentation with Y quasi-compact and quasi-separated, the lemma produces finitely many Y-schemes Z_i -> Y which are immersions of finite presentation, jointly surjective, such that each base change X x_Y Z_i -> Z_i has a section. The retained proof writes the construction in full: express Spec(k(y)) as the directed limit of the affine schemes Spec((A/I)_f) indexed by finitely generated ideals I inside the prime p and nonvanishing f, verify each is an immersion of finite presentation over Y with quasi-compactness from the quasi-separated hypothesis (Schemes, lemma-quasi-compact-permanence), promote the section over the residue field to a section over one stage via the Limits finite-presentation characterization (Limits, proposition-characterize-locally-finite-presentation), then extract a finite subcover using that constructible images (Chevalley) cover a spectral space that is quasi-compact in the constructible topology (Properties, lemma-quasi-compact-quasi-separated-spectral; Topology, lemma-constructible-hausdorff-quasi-compact). The statement block carries a reference environment citing EHIK Lemma 2.1.2. Retained author proof at lines 23206-23237.
